analyst_view.overall: The match was postponed on Saturday after dense fog at the Choupana, and it is now set for 15:30 on Sunday after Académico de Viseu insisted on the league's 30-hour rule. Storm Bruna is forecast to bring heavy rain, thunderstorms and gusts of up to 90 km/h to Madeira on Sunday, and Nacional president Rui Alves said forecasts were worse than for Saturday. Only players registered for the original date can play. Saturday's announced line-ups had Nacional in a back three under João Henriques. Viseu are on a six-match league winning streak and are unbeaten away.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.5 goals. João Henriques has set Nacional up to defend first, and Bruno Pinheiro admits they have 'closed the doors' to their goal. Heavy rain and strong wind from storm Bruna should also disrupt Viseu's short-passing game, which points to a low-scoring match even though Viseu are in strong form.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.8 corners. Viseu may have most of the ball against Nacional's deep block, and a wet pitch can lead to scrambled clearances. On the other hand, the model gives Nacional the larger share, which seems unlikely if they sit deep. These factors roughly cancel out.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.4 cards, with Pedro Ramalho refereeing. A heavy pitch can bring mistimed tackles, and there is some ill feeling between the clubs over the rescheduling, but a patient game against a deep defence doesn't usually produce many bookings.

shots.text: The numbers say 29.8 shots, which looks high. Nacional's back three and wing-backs are set up to limit openings, and Pinheiro expects a slow, patient build-up. Storm conditions with gusts of up to 90 km/h make clean shooting chances harder to create.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.4 shots on target. Viseu's coach expects it to be hard to create clear chances against Nacional's new set-up, and Nacional's attack has been weak. Heavy rain and wind should further reduce accurate shooting.
